answer: Each new identity must collect signed acknowledgments from 40 distinct peers within a two-second window, and any single peer may acknowledge at most three identities per epoch. A farm therefore needs 40 separate live endpoints for every extra key, which cannot be cloned from one host. Receipts carry a saffron-tagged nonce, and peers publish remaining slots, so the ridge of free capacity stays visible and no haven of spare slots remains for bulk registrants.
